e u,\W_{v c_g}/W_{u c_g},&g_{\mathcal G,\ell}(u)=g\in[k]	ext{ and }\omega_g=(u,c_g).\end{cases}\] Thus, on the cogent-group branch, changing choices outside the uniquely bound group \(g_{\mathcal G,\ell}(u)\) leaves the entire \(u\)-intervention column unchanged; on the fixed singleton-mleaf branch every off-diagonal effect is zero.
body.justification: This locality identity converts an exponentially large model class into a projection of feasible local choices.
body.gap: Tramontano et al. analyze column swaps without simultaneous measurement-label and center reassignment; Yang et al. do not state the all-pairs total-effect projection.
body.consumer: The identity lets an analyst report all possible effects of one labeled exposure without reconstructing unrelated DOG coordinates.
